description: The bar chart illustrates the values of ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L across different diffusion steps. The horizontal axis represents the diffusion step, labeled with values 100, 250, 500, 1000, and 2000, in ascending order. The vertical axis is unlabeled but has a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 45. The chart features grouped bars, with each group corresponding to a specific diffusion step and comprising three bars representing ROUGE-1 (blue diagonal stripes), ROUGE-2 (gray), and ROUGE-L (orange dots). The bars are grouped together, with ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L appearing in that order from left to right within each group. The values for ROUGE-1 range from 6.3 at 100 diffusion steps to 41.2 at 2000 diffusion steps. ROUGE-2 values range from 0.1 at 100 diffusion steps to 19.1 at 2000 diffusion steps. ROUGE-L values range from 3.0 at 100 diffusion steps to 33.4 at 2000 diffusion steps. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart provides a visual representation of how the ROUGE scores change as the diffusion step increases.
